settings.font_family.label: font family
settings.font_family.tip: type a font name, like fira code. off = the default. stays on this computer
settings.zoom.label: zoom
settings.zoom.tip: everything's size, 90 to 300 percent. ctrl-= / ctrl-- / ctrl-0 or ctrl-wheel anywhere. /zoom 1.5
settings.language.label: language
settings.first_glow.label: first-message glow
settings.first_glow.tip: yellow edge on someone's first message this session
settings.read_line.label: last-read line
settings.read_line.tip: a red line where you stopped reading when you left the tab or the window
settings.timestamps.label: timestamps
settings.time_fmt.label: timestamp format
settings.time_fmt.tip: clock format for chat row timestamps: 24h (16:05) or 12h (4:05pm). /timeformat 12h
settings.timestamp_seconds.label: timestamp seconds
settings.timestamp_seconds.tip: seconds on the clock: 16:05:09, or 4:05:09pm in 12h. stays on this computer. /timeseconds
settings.zebra.label: zebra striping
settings.readable.label: fix dim usernames
settings.readable.tip: brighten dim username colors so they're readable on the black bg
settings.platform_tags.label: platform tags
settings.platform_tags.tip: [T] [K] [Y] labels on messages in tabs that mix platforms
settings.avatars.label: profile pictures
settings.avatars.tip: show each person's picture next to their name
settings.paints.label: 7tv paints + badges
settings.paints.tip: name paints and 7tv badges on chatters
settings.hs_paints.label: heatsync name paints
settings.hs_paints.tip: animated name colors from heatsync. beats a 7tv paint when a chatter has both
settings.render_inventory.label: show heatsync emotes
settings.render_inventory.tip: draw the emotes people own on heatsync. off = the plain word. channel and global emotes stay on
settings.personal_emotes.label: 7tv personal emotes
settings.personal_emotes.tip: draw the personal emotes 7tv subscribers picked, in their own lines. asks 7tv about chatters in your open channels; nothing about you goes with it
settings.third_party_badges.label: third-party badges
settings.third_party_badges.tip: betterttv, frankerfacez and chatterino badges on chatters. a channel's own mod and vip badges stay either way
settings.sub_flair.label: sub flair
settings.sub_flair.tip: a small sub badge before a chatter's name, the one they picked on heatsync. twitch lines only. asks heatsync about the names on screen
settings.flame.label: heatsync user flame
settings.flame.tip: a flame before the name of a chatter you have seen use heatsync emotes. twitch lines only, never your own. a heat bar replaces it
settings.heat_bars.label: heat bars
settings.heat_bars.tip: a thin bar before a chatter's name, thicker as their heat climbs: white from 5, yellow from 50, red from 1000. twitch lines only. asks heatsync about the names on screen
settings.animate_emotes.label: animate emotes
settings.animate_emotes.tip: emotes and name paints move. never = still pictures, saves cpu. /animateemotes never
settings.pronouns.label: pronouns
settings.pronouns.tip: pronouns on the user card + name popup (twitch only)
settings.line_height.label: line height
settings.line_height.tip: chat row line height: 20 is tight, 22 and 26 add room between lines. /lineheight 22
settings.tab_side.label: tab position
settings.tab_side.tip: where the tabs sit: top, bottom, left or right. /tabs left
settings.tab_counter.label: tab counter
settings.tab_counter.tip: the number after a channel's name: unread since you looked, heat (messages in the last minute), or off. /tabcounter heat
settings.vi.label: vi mode
settings.vi.tip: vim keys on the message box, space then a key for the chat
settings.auto_hide.label: auto-hide input
settings.auto_hide.tip: hides the input bar when idle
settings.suggest_inventory.label: suggest your heatsync emotes
settings.suggest_inventory.tip: offer your heatsync emotes while you type and on tab. off leaves only channel and global emotes
settings.right_click.label: right-click an emote
settings.right_click.tip: menu = a small menu names what happens. instant = right-click just does it: yours is removed, anyone else's is blocked, a blocked one is unblocked. off = nothing. /rightclick instant
settings.remember_sent.label: remember sent messages
settings.remember_sent.tip: up and down in the box recall what you sent, also after a restart. kept on this computer only, the newest 50. off = memory only, and the saved copy goes. /clearsent forgets them now
settings.my_commands.label: your commands
settings.my_commands.tip: your own slash commands: /gg good game {1}. {1} {2} are words you type, {1+} the rest, {input} everything, {channel}, {user}. enter opens the list: a adds, x removes. a built-in command with the same name always wins
settings.media.label: inline media
settings.media.tip: show images, gifs and link cards inline in chat
settings.link_previews.label: link previews
settings.link_previews.tip: show a preview card (title and picture) under links to sites heatsync can preview
settings.links.label: clickable links
settings.dim_timeouts.label: dim timed-out messages
settings.dim_timeouts.tip: a timed-out or banned person's lines go dim and lose their pictures. off leaves them as they were
settings.collapse_timeouts.label: fold timeout runs
settings.collapse_timeouts.tip: timeouts and bans in a row fold into one line, 5 people timed out. click or enter opens it. a chat line between them ends the run. off shows each one
settings.hover_reply.label: reply button on hover
settings.hover_reply.tip: a ↪ button on the line under the pointer: one click starts a reply, same as reply in the line menu
settings.updates.label: check for updates
settings.updates.tip: look for a new version on github every few hours; a ↑ button on the tab bar installs it in one click
settings.chat_logs.label: save chat logs
settings.chat_logs.tip: saved on this computer, one file a day per channel. never uploaded, whispers never saved
settings.notify.label: desktop notifications
settings.notify.tip: show a desktop notification when someone @s you, or a channel goes live or switches game, and the window is not focused
settings.mention_volume.label: mention sound volume
settings.mention_volume.tip: a ping when someone @s you and the window is not focused. 0 = silent. /mentionsound 50
settings.mention_sound_when.label: mention sound plays
settings.mention_sound_when.tip: away = only while the window is in the background. always = also while you are looking at it. rule sounds always play. /mentionsoundwhen always
settings.ping_sound.label: mention sound
settings.ping_sound.tip: which sound plays when someone @s you: ping, blip, knock, chime, or custom (your own wav file, set in custom sound file). you hear it as you pick. stays on this computer. /pingsound chime
settings.ping_file.label: custom sound file
settings.ping_file.tip: a .wav file, up to 2mb and 3 seconds. only plays when mention sound is custom, and picking a file turns custom on. off = the ping again
settings.mention_rules.label: mention rules
settings.mention_rules.tip: words the server watches for in every channel and pings you with here, like an @. enter opens the list: a adds, enter turns one on or off, x removes. needs a heatsync login
settings.title_flash.label: title flash
settings.title_flash.tip: the window title flashes who @'d you until you come back to the window
settings.taskbar_flash.label: taskbar flash
settings.taskbar_flash.tip: your taskbar entry lights up when someone @s you and the window is not in front. muted channels and streamer mode hold it back, like the ping. stays on this computer
settings.streamer.label: streamer mode
settings.streamer.tip: hides whisper text, link previews and popup text, and mutes sounds, so nothing private shows on stream. auto = on while obs is running. space s or a click on a hidden line shows the whispers tab for this session
settings.streamer_sounds.label: keep sounds
settings.streamer_sounds.tip: the mention ping and rule sounds still play while streamer mode is on
settings.whisper_toast.label: whisper toast
settings.whisper_toast.tip: popup toast when a whisper or dm arrives while you are on another tab — click it to jump to whispers
settings.ev_online.label: went live
settings.ev_online.tip: line when a channel goes live
settings.ev_offline.label: went offline
settings.ev_offline.tip: line when a channel goes offline (off by default, noisy)
settings.ev_game.label: game switches
settings.ev_game.tip: line when a streamer changes the game
settings.ev_raid.label: raids
settings.ev_raid.tip: line when a channel starts a raid
settings.ev_sub.label: gift bombs
settings.ev_sub.tip: a line when someone gifts a batch of subs
settings.ev_redeem.label: redeems
settings.ev_redeem.tip: line when someone redeems a channel-point reward
settings.ev_pred.label: prediction banner
settings.ev_pred.tip: a line under the tabs while a twitch prediction is open; click it to see it all
settings.moments.label: moment alerts
settings.moments.tip: a channel's chat suddenly explodes: a heat spike line in that tab
settings.mod_buttons.label: mod toolbar buttons
settings.mod_buttons.tip: pick which buttons show on a line: delete, timeouts, ban, unban. enter lets you pick
settings.confirm_ban.label: confirm before ban
settings.confirm_ban.tip: ask before a permanent ban goes out: guards against a misclick (ban reasons ask too)
settings.ban_reasons.label: ban reasons
settings.ban_reasons.tip: quick reasons offered when you ban (a ban then always asks first). enter opens the list: a adds, x removes
settings.hide_bots.label: hide bots
settings.hide_bots.tip: hide messages from known chat bots (nightbot, streamelements, fossabot...)
settings.hide_cmds.label: hide !commands
settings.hide_dupes.label: hide duplicates
settings.hide_dupes.tip: collapse identical consecutive messages (spam waves) to the first one
settings.filter_rules.label: filter rules
settings.filter_rules.tip: rules that hide or highlight lines, by word or by user, badge and more. the first hide wins. enter opens the list: a adds (hide spoilers), x removes
settings.people.label: muted & blocked people
settings.people.tip: everyone you muted, blocked or hid. enter opens the list: x lets one back in, enter on a name opens their card
settings.show_nsfw.label: show nsfw
settings.show_nsfw.tip: sexual pictures and emotes (flagged by moderation). hidden behind a show button when off
settings.show_violence.label: show violence
settings.show_violence.tip: gore and violence. hidden behind a show button when off
settings.show_weapons.label: show weapons
settings.show_weapons.tip: weapons. hidden behind a show button when off
settings.show_drugs.label: show drugs
settings.show_drugs.tip: drugs. hidden behind a show button when off
settings.show_hate.label: show hate speech
settings.show_hate.tip: hate symbols and speech. hidden behind a show button when off
settings.tab_feed.label: feed tab
settings.tab_feed.tip: the heatsync social feed, shown in the tab bar
settings.tab_whispers.label: whispers tab
settings.tab_whispers.tip: your twitch whispers, shown in the tab bar
settings.tab_mentions.label: mentions tab
settings.tab_mentions.tip: every @mention of you, shown in the tab bar
settings.tab_modlog.label: mod log tab
settings.tab_modlog.tip: every ban, timeout, unban and delete seen in your channels, shown in the tab bar
settings.tour.right_click.title: right-click a line
settings.tour.right_click.line1: a menu opens: reply, copy, mute and more.
settings.tour.right_click.line2: no mouse? alt-r picks a line, then enter.
settings.tour.slash.title: type / for commands
settings.tour.slash.line1: in the box at the bottom, a list pops up.
settings.tour.find.title: find a line
settings.tour.find.line2: only the matching lines stay. esc clears.
settings.tour.channel.title: add a channel
settings.tour.channel.line2: alt-1 to alt-9 jump between tabs.
settings.tour.settings.title: settings
settings.tour.settings.line1: click the gear or press ctrl-, for settings.
settings.tour.settings.line2: the ? or f1 shows every key.
settings.tour.off.title: these start off
settings.tour.off.line1: j k pick one, space turns it on.
settings.tour.hint_last: space switch · enter done · ← back · esc skip
settings.screen.reset_tip: puts every look and behaviour setting back to its default. keeps your login, your tabs and which built-in tabs show, filter rules, muted and blocked people, mention rules, notes and everything saved
settings.screen.reset_ask: reset every look and behaviour setting to its default? your login, tabs, filter rules, people lists, mention rules and notes stay · y resets · any other key keeps
settings.screen.keys_tip_vi: vi rows work in normal mode: esc leaves typing first
settings.screen.keys_tip_plain: dim vi rows need vi mode: /vi turns it on, then esc leaves typing and they work
settings.screen.head: {cat} · {section}
settings.screen.logs_here: saving chat logs on this computer
settings.screen.words_bad: {label} is too long or has odd characters
settings.screen.modbuttons_usage: usage: /modbuttons x 1m 10m 1h 24h 7d purge ban unban (or off)
settings.screen.reset_done: settings are back to their defaults
settings.screen.hint_filter: type to filter · enter or esc stops
settings.screen.hint_add_term: type a term · enter adds · esc stops
settings.screen.hint_blocked: j k move · x delete · a add · / filter · esc closes
settings.screen.hint_settings_typing: type to filter · enter or esc stops · up down moves
settings.screen.hint_settings: j k move · space change · / search · ? keys · esc
settings.screen.hint_pred: read only · j k scroll · r refresh · esc closes
settings.screen.hint_account: j k move · enter picks · esc closes
settings.screen.hint_following: j k move · enter opens a tab · w watches · r refreshes · / filter · esc closes
settings.screen.hint_import: space picks · enter adds · s picks live · r reloads · / filter · esc
settings.screen.hint_summary: counted live from when this window joined · esc closes
settings.screen.hint_modtools: j k move · enter flips · h l level · y approve · x deny · r reload · esc
settings.screen.hint_status_blocked: j k move · enter flips · h l wait · esc closes
settings.screen.hint_status: j k move · enter opens · esc closes
settings.screen.hint_keys: j k scroll · ? settings · esc closes
settings.lists.hint.people: enter opens their card · x lets them back
settings.lists.hint.rules: type hide or highlight, then a word: hide spoilers · ? more
settings.lists.hint.reasons: quick reasons offered when you ban
settings.lists.hint.buttons: enter turns a button on or off · they show on the line under the pointer in rooms you moderate
settings.lists.hint.commands: type: /name what it says. {1} {2} words · {1+} the rest · {input} all · {channel} · {user}
settings.lists.hint.alerts: the server watches every channel for a word or phrase and pings you here · ? more
settings.lists.more.rules: more kinds: put user, badge, msgtype, regex or expr before the value, like highlight user bob or hide regex ^! · a highlight can play your own wav: /rule sound <number> <path>
settings.lists.more.alerts: more: phrase big news · regex ^hi · end with #channel to keep it to one channel
settings.lists.keys.edit: enter saves · esc leaves it as it was
settings.lists.keys.alerts: j k move · a add · enter on or off · x delete · ? more · esc closes
settings.lists.keys.rules: j k move · a add · e edit · n notify · s sound · + - volume · x delete · ? more · esc closes
settings.lists.keys.addable: j k move · a add · x delete · esc closes
settings.lists.keys.buttons: j k move · enter on or off · esc closes
settings.lists.keys.people: j k move · enter opens their card · x lets them back · esc closes
settings.lists.try.no_lines: no lines here to try it on yet
settings.lists.try.none: matches none of the last {n} messages
settings.import.title: import follows
settings.import.title_cut: import follows · showing the first {n} — live first
settings.import.title_ready: import follows · {n} to add · {live} live now
settings.import.login: log in with twitch to import your follows, sorted by who's live
settings.import.expired: your twitch link expired — reconnect it to import follows
settings.import.scope: your twitch link doesn't include follows — reconnect it to import them
settings.import.down: couldn't reach twitch — try again in a minute
settings.import.none: you don't follow anyone on twitch yet
settings.import.all_here: every channel you follow is already here
settings.import.relinking: finish reconnecting twitch in your browser…
settings.import.nothing_added: nothing added — those are already in your tabs
settings.inventory.empty.mine: no emotes yet: add some from the picker (ctrl-;), or i imports a channel's
settings.inventory.empty.sets: no saved sets: save one on heatsync.org
settings.inventory.sure_apply: replace your emotes with "{name}"?  y yes · n no
settings.inventory.title: emotes · {tabs}
settings.inventory.tip.rename: one word, no spaces; the case you type is the case chat reads
settings.inventory.tip.move: a slot from 0 to 4999; a slot with an emote in it trades places with this one
settings.inventory.tip.import: adds a channel's 7tv, bttv and ffz emotes to yours; ones you already have are skipped
settings.inventory.tip.unshare: turn off your share link? the old link stops working for good
settings.inventory.tip.mine: your heatsync emotes, by slot. J and K swap a slot with its neighbour
settings.inventory.tip.removed: emotes you removed stay here for a while: enter puts one back
settings.inventory.tip.sets: applying a set replaces your emotes; the old ones go to removed
settings.inventory.keys.filter: type to filter · enter or esc stops
settings.inventory.keys.mine: j k · J K carry · n name · m slot · x remove · u undo · s share · i import · [ ] tab
settings.inventory.keys.removed: j k move · enter restores · [ ] tab · / filter · esc closes
settings.inventory.keys.sets: j k move · enter applies · [ ] tab · / filter · esc closes
settings.inventory.clear_filter: clear the filter to carry a slot
settings.inventory.removed_msg: removed {name}: u undoes, or restore it from removed
settings.inventory.unshared: sharing is off: the old link is dead
